'''Larence Zaprin''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with [[Zaprin family|his family]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote| There's a serious medical situation on Naboo. A family that is living in the relative wilderness of Naboo has been attacked by a number of feral creatures. Several of the family members need tending.|[[2-1b-58|Billingsly]], to a medic|<ref name="SWG:HC" />}}
[[File:Zaprin_Estate_exterior.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The [[Zaprin Estate]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Larence Zaprin lived in his [[Zaprin Estate|estate]] in the remote wilderness of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] with his wife, his daughter [[Mia Zaprin|Mia]] and his son [[Jowres Zaprin|Jowres]].<ref name="SWG:HC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of sick [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatchs]] and [[Mott/Legends|motts]] surrounded his home. When his children [[Mia Zaprin|Mia]] and [[Jowres Zaprin|Jowres]] left the house, they were attacked and infected with an unknown illness. Zaprin sent an urgent request for a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] to help his sick children. A short time later, a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] sent by the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] reached the Zaprin estate and managed to create an anti-toxin to cure the children. Zaprin didn't have enough money to pay the medic the full amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], so he gave him a [[Striker projectile pistol|field surgeon pistol]] to cover the remainder of the cost.<ref name="SWG:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larence Zaprin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Larence Zaprin was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Larence Zaprin could be found in a remote building in the Nabooian mountains south-east of the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]]. He was part of the quest "[[W:c:swg:House Call|House Call]]" for players of the [[:w:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]].<ref name="SWG:HC" />
